implementation_constraints: plain JavaScript, Node >= 18, no dependencies, CommonJS
reads one JSON value from stdin, prints one line, exits 0; module.exports + require.main guard

unresolved_intent.decision: Compact JSON via JSON.stringify() with no extra whitespace
unresolved_intent.rationale: Spec explicitly states formatting is not fixed by the spec, only structure and values; compact is standard and efficient for streaming output

unresolved_intent.decision: Append newline after ERROR string (output is ERROR\n)
unresolved_intent.rationale: Spec says 'print exactly ERROR' but line-oriented programs terminate each output line; consistent with JSON output format which is also line-terminated

unresolved_intent.decision: Buffer entire stdin before parsing, then parse once
unresolved_intent.rationale: Spec requires exactly one JSON object per execution; buffering is simpler and safer than stream parsing for single-object input

unresolved_intent.decision: Silently ignore extra properties in input object
unresolved_intent.rationale: Spec specifies required properties (capacity, refill, events) but does not forbid additional ones; ignoring extras follows standard JSON practice

unresolved_intent.decision: Output tokens as JavaScript number in JSON (not string)
unresolved_intent.rationale: Spec designates tokens as int and provides no special encoding; JSON numbers are the native representation
